notes.title: The Big Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hi Perverts, woah… It’s been a while. 

So what happend in all these months? Well let us explain: 

We had a developer where we were very happy with in the beginning.. but in the end it just ended up in a mess what slowed down the development for 7 months. Well now we are finally here with the update! 

We reworked the entire game. We build it up from zero in code to have more control over the entire game without any restrictions. There is a graphical overhaul with updated lighting, textures and visuals.  We also worked on the User Interface, with a much more clean look.   
- Added the University Level (seated gameplay)
- Added a tablet to function as your inventory, camera etc. 
- Some secrets for you to find in each level.


Ofcourse this is not all. In the mean time we developed Perv Simulator for PC! This will be soon available in the Steam Store but you can already wishlist it! So please do :)


Have fun perverts! 
- The Teluma Games Team.

notes.title: Update #2 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've noticed some problems with players spawning outside the basement and falling in to space. Being unable to play the game.  We have fixed this by spawning the player in the middle of the basement. 

We've also moved the red button to turn on the lights.

notes.title: Perv Simulator VR | Content Update #1: The Basement
notes.notes:
Hi Pervs, thank you all for playing our game Perv Simulator VR. 

We introduce The Basement. 

The basement will be the player’s hideout and will replace the current main menu. After each mission, you will return to the basement to store your collected trophies, and choose your pervert’s disguise. 

As a player, it is now possible to choose a different disguise every time you go out on your nightly endeavors.

Our updates will come often and soon, so if you are still on the fence if being a virtual pervert is for you, we can assure you that this month is the time to get on the early access train.

Enjoy this update! 

- The Teluma Games Team

notes.title: Update #1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi Perverts! 

First of all we want to thank you all for playing our game, we are very happy with the results and you've only seen the tip of the iceberg! 

For now we have a small update to fix some bugs: 

- Added the option to run after walking forwards for more than 2 seconds. This improves the gameplay and makes it easier to walk around 
- Collisions on the house model are fixed. Before you could glitch into the roof and see the entire house, and Stacey in the shower.. you glitchy pervert ;)
- Fixed a physics bug that could launch you in to space when picking up a ladder 

Also, this Wednesday we have little trailer showing new content: The Basement. 
The basement will be your headquarters and will replace the current main menu. 

See you Wednesday Perverts! 

- The Teluma Games Team

notes.title: Early Acces release is here!
notes.notes:
We have put a lot of work in Perv Simulator VR. We worked on the concept, brainstorming, visualizing, modeling, recording sounds, rigging, come up with new game mechanics, build a level in Lego (in real life ;) just to optimize the map) and much more! 

Right now we are sitting here at the office with a small bottle of champagne and a couple of beers to celebrate our first (ever) release. There is much, much more content to come. (and some of it already finished) also we have a visualized roadmap here at the office with upcoming content, a storyline and some surprises. 

It's early acces, we want you all to have a great time and please tell us all what you think.

Enjoy perverts!


The Teluma Games Team.
